chunks: Indeed, Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, sees only good.
ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq say about how Allah perceives all things?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) to elucidate the concept of *al-Hasan* (the Good) as the fundamental attribute of Divine Reality, where God perceives only goodness in His creation. This aligns with the Shia theological emphasis on *al-Hikmah* (Wisdom) and *al-Lutf* (Divine Grace), affirming that even apparent evils are subsumed within a greater, ultimate good from the Divine perspective. It serves as a foundation for the believer's *tawakkul* (trust) and *husn al-zann* (good opinion) of Allah amidst life's trials.
